description: Inspect the agent-harness installation, shared skills, docs, and native Codex/Claude integration status.
name: harness_inspect

description: Run a read-only git preflight for the atomic-commit-push workflow: branch/upstream, staged/unstaged/untracked files, secret-like paths, and commit style hints.

path.description: Git repository path. Defaults to the agent project directory.

name: atomic_commit_preflight

description: Return the Conventional Commit + Lore body policy used by this harness.
name: commit_policy

description: List shared skills exposed by the harness and their metadata.
name: skill_manifest

description: Return a lightweight index of AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GENIUS_THINK.md, .agent-harness markdown files, and self-* skill docs: relative path, title, headings, and byte size.
name: docs_index

description: Given a task, return the project AGENTS.md and .agent-harness documents an agent should read before working.

repo.description: Target repository path. Defaults to current directory.

task.description: Task description such as commit, test, architecture, dependency, deploy, or general.

name: project_docs_route

description: Dry-run the project docs bootstrap that creates or updates AGENTS.md and .agent-harness/*.md from repository evidence. This tool never writes files.

repo.description: Target repository path. Defaults to current directory.

name: project_docs_bootstrap_plan

description: Read one allowed .agent-harness project document and return its content plus SHA-256. Use before project_docs_update so autonomous doc refreshes preserve user consensus and avoid stale overwrites.

rel_path.description: Allowed project doc path, for example .agent-harness/TESTING.md or TESTING.md.

repo.description: Target repository path. Defaults to current directory.

name: project_docs_read

description: Update one allowed .agent-harness project document after reading repo evidence and preserving user consensus. Dry-run unless confirm=true. Existing files require expected_sha256 from project_docs_read. Do not use for solved false cases or ADR entries; use project_docs_record there.

confirm.description: Set true to write. Omit or false for dry-run preview.

content.description: Full replacement content for the one document. Preserve stronger existing local guidance and user decisions.

evidence.description: Files, commands, tests, or user instructions that justify the update.

expected_sha256.description: SHA-256 returned by project_docs_read. Required when the file exists.

rel_path.description: Allowed project doc path under .agent-harness, for example .agent-harness/OPERATIONS.md.

repo.description: Target repository path. Defaults to current directory.

summary.description: Short reason for the update and how it maintains current consensus.

name: project_docs_update

description: Append a durable project note to .agent-harness/CAUTIONS.md after a solved problem/false case, or to .agent-harness/ADR.md after a decision with rationale. Use only when there is a concrete issue resolved or decision made; this tool writes files.

consequences.description: Expected follow-up consequences for ADR records.

decision.description: Chosen decision; use for ADR records.

evidence.description: Commands, files, tests, or source evidence.

kind.description: caution for solved problems/false cases; adr for decisions.

repo.description: Target repository path. Defaults to current directory.

resolution.description: How the problem was solved; use for caution records.

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the issue or decision.

name: project_docs_record

description: Run the API documentation review gate on staged or explicit controller/DTO/handler/OpenAPI files. By default it reviews only git staged API candidate files and does not fail unrelated legacy Swagger/OpenAPI debt. Use for endpoint, controller, DTO, schema, or OpenAPI changes.

all.description: When true, review all tracked API candidate files. Default false keeps scope to staged changes.

diff_file.description: Optional file containing a diff to review instead of git diff --cached.

files.description: Explicit API candidate files. Omit to use staged controller/DTO/handler/OpenAPI files.

reasoning.description: Codex reasoning effort. Defaults to medium.

repo.description: Target git repository path. Defaults to current directory.

name: api_doc_review

description: Run deterministic API documentation checks for syntax-level Swagger/OpenAPI omissions such as missing operation descriptions, params, body/query/header docs, 400/401 responses, and NestJS DTO decorators. Use before api_doc_review.

all.description: When true, check all tracked API candidate files. Default false keeps scope to staged changes.

files.description: Explicit API candidate files. Omit to use staged controller/DTO/handler/OpenAPI files.

repo.description: Target git repository path. Defaults to current directory.

name: api_doc_static_check

shell_allowed.description: Whether shell interpreter argv[0] is allowed.

shell_reason.description: Required reason when shell_allowed is true.

name: command_policy_check

argv.description: Command argv array. Shell strings are not accepted.

audit_log_id.description: Optional caller-provided audit log correlation id.

cwd.description: Command working directory; must be inside workspace_root.

shell_allowed.description: Whether shell interpreter argv[0] is allowed.

shell_reason.description: Required reason when shell_allowed is true.

name: command_fake_run

key.description: State key, max 128 chars, no path separators.

name: state_write

description: Read an agent state checkpoint by key.
name: state_read

description: List agent state checkpoint keys and metadata.
name: state_list

confirm.description: When true, delete matching records; false or omitted performs a dry-run.

max_age.description: Duration such as 720h or 168h. Must be positive.

name: state_prune

description: Inspect agent state checkpoint files for invalid JSON, key mismatches, byte-count drift, invalid timestamps, and unexpected files without modifying state.
name: state_doctor

description: Migrate valid legacy state checkpoints to the current schema. Defaults to dry-run; pass confirm=true to rewrite eligible records.

confirm.description: When true, rewrite legacy records; false or omitted performs a dry-run.

name: state_migrate

description: Start an IssueOps loop and persist its issue-driven workflow state under harness state.

repo.description: Repository path this IssueOps loop belongs to.

name: issueops_start

description: Read a persisted IssueOps loop by id.
name: issueops_status

description: Record the raw user request, interpreted intent, success criteria, constraints, non-goals, and ambiguity ledger before an IssueOps loop may enter planning.

ambiguities.description: Resolved, deferred, or blocking ambiguity ledger entries.

intent_class.description: Intent class controlling plan-prep gate strictness: trivial skips the gate, other classes enforce it.

interpreted_intent.description: Main agent interpretation of the user's intent.

name: issueops_record_intent

description: Record the pre-plan evidence gate for an IssueOps loop: prior-decision lookup, related-issue scoring, and web research. Each item takes either evidence or a mutually-exclusive waive reason. Required before entering the plan phase for non-trivial intent classes.

decisions_evidence.description: Prior-decision evidence such as ADR or decision links.

related_score_ref.description: remote score result summary (selected/rejected candidates, threshold).

web_research_evidence.description: Web research evidence such as research file paths or sources.

name: issueops_plan_prep_record

description: Attach a GitHub/GitLab issue URL to an IssueOps loop. The loop moves to plan phase only when its intent contract is recorded.
name: issueops_link_issue

description: Record provider-linked issue branch preparation and expose the required MCP-first, provider API fallback, fail-closed order. This must be used before creating a local worktree for an IssueOps issue branch.

branch.description: Provider-linked branch name, such as 2386-title or 2387-title. For GitLab, the full branch name must start with the issue number followed by a hyphen so the issue Development section links it.

link_verified.description: Whether the provider issue UI/API was verified to show the branch link.

remote_branch_url.description: Optional provider branch URL after creation.

name: issueops_prepare_branch

description: Attach the exact existing issue-driven worktree path that mutating tool guards must target. Requires linked issue and verified provider branch evidence.
name: issueops_link_worktree

description: Record the reviewed IssueOps design, refactor boundary, alternatives, risks, verification matrix, and approval before implementation. When approved=true, include refactor_plan, at least one alternative, at least one risk, no open_questions, and a verification item such as "design review checked alternatives and risks"; design_review_evidence is not a separate field.

approved.description: Whether the design is approved for implementation.

open_questions.description: Open design questions. Must be empty when approved is true.

verification.description: Verification steps. For approved=true, one item must be design review evidence, for example: design review checked alternatives and risks. Add normal test commands as separate items.

name: issueops_review_design

description: Attach the issue-driven plan path to an IssueOps loop. Requires linked issue, verified provider branch evidence, linked worktree, and approved design review. This does not enter implementation by itself; run issueops_prepare_worktree_tools to prepare dependencies and CodeGraph for the linked worktree before implementation.
name: issueops_link_plan

description: Prepare the linked IssueOps worktree before implementation by checking dependencies, installing supported missing dependencies, and initializing CodeGraph against the exact worktree path. The result is persisted on the IssueOps record and gates implementation readiness.
name: issueops_prepare_worktree_tools

description: Record the durable pre-implementation execution decision: auto-proceed boundaries, hook-blocked work, human gates, and whether sub-agents are not used or explicitly planned from the documented allowlist.

auto_proceed.description: Conditions under which the main agent may continue without asking again.

hook_blocked.description: Workflow actions hooks must not perform.

subagent_plans.description: Required when subagent_use=planned. Each plan must use a documented sub-agent pattern and benefit, list the tradeoffs, and explain why the plan remains net-positive.

net_positive_rationale.description: Why the expected benefit outweighs the recorded tradeoffs for this specific task.

tradeoffs.description: Known costs such as limited mid-run steering, reduced visibility, added latency/token cost, or coordination overhead.

subagent_rationale.description: Required when subagent_use=none; optional top-level rationale when planned.

name: issueops_record_execution_decision

description: Record the IssueOps compatibility-review phase: backward compatibility findings, side effects, rollback plan, verification evidence, unresolved blockers, and approval before implementation may proceed.

approved.description: Whether compatibility and side effects are resolved enough to proceed.

backward_compatibility.description: Findings about existing public behavior, state JSON, CLI/MCP/API, schema, or migration compatibility.

blockers.description: Unresolved blockers. Must be empty when approved is true.

rollback_plan.description: Concrete rollback or mitigation path if the compatibility review was wrong.

side_effects.description: Expected side effects and their affected surfaces.

verification.description: Verification evidence for compatibility and side effects.

name: issueops_record_compatibility_review

description: Record the brooks devil's-advocate verdict on the completed plan: pass, revise, or stop, with surfaced findings and an optional explicit waiver. A recorded pass (or a waived stop/revise) is a fail-closed precondition of implement entry; a stop is reflected into the remote issue before the cycle regresses.

findings.description: Surfaced problems. Required for a stop/revise verdict unless waived.

verdict.description: Devil's-advocate verdict: pass, revise, or stop.

waived.description: Explicitly waive a stop/revise verdict to proceed.

waiver_rationale.description: Rationale required when waived is true.

name: issueops_record_devils_advocate_review

description: Record the IssueOps grill-phase domain review: terminology, how the change fits the current domain model, risks, and unresolved uncertainties. Backs the grill domain_review phase-ledger artifact.

model_fit.description: How the change fits the current domain model. Required unless terminology is provided.

open_uncertainties.description: Unresolved uncertainties to carry into planning.

name: issueops_record_domain_review

description: Record AI-slop-clean evidence: which cleanup categories were checked or cleaned and which verifications were rerun afterwards. Backs the ai-slop-clean cleanup_evidence and verification_evidence phase-ledger artifacts.
name: issueops_record_ai_slop_clean_evidence

description: Record the resolution outcome of an IssueOps feedback item by index. Backs the feedback feedback_resolution phase-ledger artifact.

index.description: 0-based index of the feedback item to resolve.

name: issueops_resolve_feedback

description: Take the IssueOps feedback loop backward when the Brooks devil's advocate returns a stop verdict: regress a plan or compatibility-review cycle to grill so scope is re-investigated and the plan redone. Records the stop reason as a scope decision, clears the rejected design's approval, and marks the plan/compatibility-review ledger entries stale. Does not delete the worktree, branch, or remote artifacts.

reason.description: The Brooks stop verdict / why the plan must be redone.

name: issueops_regress_for_replan

description: Record an existing provider-native child work item for an IssueOps loop, such as a GitHub sub-issue or GitLab child item.

child_url.description: GitHub sub-issue or GitLab child item URL.

name: issueops_link_child

description: Record a typed relationship between the current IssueOps issue and another issue. Supports depends-on, blocks, supersedes, follows-up, duplicates, splits-from, and implements link types. Unlike link-child, this does not require the linked issue to be in the same project.

title.description: Optional title of the related issue.

name: issueops_link_related

description: Record an explicit decision for an IssueOps loop with kind, rationale, alternatives, affected issue links, and affected artifacts. Unlike feedback (which captures external input), decisions capture internal product/architecture/implementation/test/review/scope choices.

affected_artifacts.description: Affected artifacts: issue, plan, test, implementation, review, pr_mr, follow-up.

affected_issue_links.description: Affected issue URLs from the issue graph.

name: issueops_add_decision

description: Record that a pioneer/CS skill (codd, dijkstra, hopper, shannon, etc.) actually fired at the current IssueOps phase during this run. Captures a live (phase, skill) routing pairing so skill_routing_fidelity can be scored against observed activation instead of a synthesized trace. Idempotent per (phase, skill).

phase.description: Lifecycle phase at which the skill fired, such as plan, implement, or grill.

skill.description: Skill that fired, such as codd, dijkstra, hopper, shannon, karpathy, turing, von-neumann, or berners-lee.

name: issueops_record_routing

description: Record user or review feedback for an IssueOps loop and move it to the feedback phase.

classification.description: Optional feedback classification, such as contract_change, defect, question, or noise.

source.description: Feedback source, such as user, review, CI, or QA.

name: issueops_add_feedback

description: Record that unresolved contract_change feedback has been reflected in the remote issue body, unblocking PR readiness.
name: issueops_mark_issue_updated

description: Advance an IssueOps loop to a named lifecycle phase (problem, grill, plan, compatibility-review, implement, ai-slop-clean, feedback, pr, done). The plan phase requires a linked issue and recorded intent contract; compatibility-review requires linked issue, provider-linked branch, linked worktree, approved design review, and linked plan; implement additionally requires approved compatibility review, durable worktree preparation, and execution decision; ai-slop-clean additionally requires implementation changes; pr requires strict PR readiness; done requires prior pr phase plus verified remote PR/MR artifact state (unless force=true).

force.description: When true and phase is done, bypass remote artifact verification requirement. The skip reason is recorded in force_release_reason.

phase.description: Target phase: problem, grill, plan, compatibility-review, implement, ai-slop-clean, feedback, pr, or done.

to.description: Compatibility alias for phase, matching the CLI --to flag.

name: issueops_set_phase

description: Record that the created PR/MR was verified remotely with URL, labels, and assignees before the IssueOps loop may enter done.
name: issueops_verify_remote_artifact

description: Report whether an IssueOps loop has the issue, plan, exact worktree, clean git state, and upstream sync needed before drafting a PR or MR.

strict.description: When true, require linked worktree path, clean git status, matching branch, existing plan path, upstream, and 0/0 divergence.

name: issueops_pr_readiness

description: Report whether a merged IssueOps PR/MR is ready for local cleanup before deleting worktrees or branches. Linked child tasks must have verified child-only close evidence; parent issues remain open umbrella issues.

merged.description: Whether the remote PR/MR merge was verified before cleanup.

name: issueops_cleanup_status

description: Dry-run or execute child-only cleanup after a child PR/MR has been verified merged into its parent work branch. Closes linked GitHub sub-issues or GitLab child work items only; the parent issue stays open as the umbrella. Set confirm=true to mutate remote state and record close verification evidence.

confirm.description: When true, close linked child tasks remotely and record verified close evidence. Defaults to false dry-run preview.

merged.description: Whether the child PR/MR merge into the parent work branch was verified before closing child tasks.

name: issueops_cleanup_close_children

description: Scan a repo's non-done IssueOps cycles and classify abandoned ones using multi-signal liveness (confirmed-stale: worktree deleted/reused; likely-done: remote branch merged/absent; needs-review: idle past max-age). Reports only by default; set apply to force-release confirmed-stale and likely-done cycles. Maintenance tool; runs off the hot path and may consult git/remote.

apply.description: When true, force-release confirmed-stale and likely-done cycles. needs-review is always report-only. Defaults to false (report only).

max_age.description: Age in days after which an idle non-done cycle is flagged needs-review. Defaults to 14.

prune_done.description: Go duration (e.g. 720h) after which done cycles are pruned; only takes effect together with apply. Defaults to 720h (30 days), matching the CLI --prune-done flag.

repo.description: Source repository path whose cycles are scanned.

name: issueops_cleanup_stale

description: Deterministically score related issue and label candidates for a new IssueOps issue and select only those at/above the threshold. Read-only background_join gate; join before any remote artifact write.

issue.description: The new issue artifact being scored.

issue_candidates.description: Existing related issue candidates to score.

provider.description: Remote provider: github or gitlab. Defaults to github.

threshold.description: Selection cutoff from 0 to 1. Defaults to 0.70.

name: issueops_remote_score

description: Force-release a stuck IssueOps cycle to done, bypassing phase gate requirements. Use only when a cycle is deadlocked and cannot complete normally (e.g. missing remote_artifact verification). Requires an explicit reason recorded in the cycle state.

id.description: IssueOps id of the stuck cycle.

reason.description: Reason for force-release, recorded in the cycle state for audit.

name: issueops_force_release

description: Render and validate a canonical Korean IssueOps remote issue, child task, or PR/MR body from the shared core template policy without mutating provider state.

fields.description: Template field values keyed by canonical field name or documented alias.

provider.description: Remote provider for provider-specific body rules.

score_result.description: Optional structured score result; score_summary takes precedence when both are supplied.

score_summary.description: Related issue and label scoring summary to include in the rendered artifact.

name: issueops_remote_render_template

description: Create a remote issue (GitHub/GitLab) for the IssueOps cycle. Dry-run by default; pass confirm=true to execute. Returns the URL of the created issue or a preview of what would be created.

confirm.description: Set true to execute; omit for dry-run preview.

fields.description: Template field values keyed by canonical field name or documented alias.

id.description: IssueOps id. The provider is inferred from the cycle's issue_url or branch_prepare records.

score_summary.description: Related issue and label scoring summary.

template.description: Optional canonical template kind to render or validate.

name: issueops_remote_create_issue

description: Create a provider-native child work item under the linked parent issue, verify hierarchy/labels/assignees, then record the child link in IssueOps state when confirm=true. Dry-run by default.

assignees.description: Assignee usernames to apply and verify on the child.

confirm.description: Set true to create, attach, verify, and record the child; omit for dry-run preview.

fields.description: Template field values keyed by canonical field name or documented alias.

id.description: IssueOps id. The parent issue URL and provider are inferred from the cycle state.

labels.description: Labels to apply and verify on the child.

score_summary.description: Related issue and label scoring summary.

template.description: Optional canonical template kind to render or validate.

name: issueops_remote_create_child

description: Create a remote pull request / merge request for the IssueOps cycle. Dry-run by default; pass confirm=true to execute. Provider and branch info are inferred from the cycle state (branch_prepare, branch, remote_artifact).

confirm.description: Set true to execute; omit for dry-run preview.

fields.description: Template field values keyed by canonical field name or documented alias.

score_summary.description: Related issue and label scoring summary.

template.description: Optional canonical template kind to render or validate.

name: issueops_remote_create_pr

description: Sync the local IssueOps issue graph (typed related-issue links) to the remote issue as a comment listing each link. Dry-run by default; pass confirm=true to post the comment. Helps collaborators see the decision structure directly on the remote issue.

confirm.description: Set true to post the comment; omit for dry-run preview.

name: issueops_remote_sync_graph

description: Read the session-to-cycle binding for a repo and return the current IssueOps cycle state, worktree path, branch, readiness, and suggested next actions. When unbound, suggests active cycles for the repo. Optionally bind the session with --bind.

bind.description: When true and a cycle is found, bind the session to it.

name: issueops_resume

description: Report whether the shared agent-harness daemon backing this MCP proxy is reachable, including socket and pid metadata.
name: daemon_status

description: Plan the self-augmentation loop: use GENIUS_THINK.md, repo signals, and research-backed strategies to choose concrete feature/performance/quality improvements. The native skill performs implementation; this tool exposes the scoring contract and candidate curriculum, and can persist the chosen plan to harness state for durable Reflexion-style memory.

cycles.description: Number of autonomous improvement cycles to plan; defaults to 1.

save_state.description: When true, save the selected self-augmentation plan to harness state.

state_key.description: State key for save_state; defaults to self-augment-latest.

target_score.description: Exclusive per-goal score threshold; defaults to 95.

name: self_augment

description: Store a Reflexion-style self-augmentation lesson in harness state for durable cross-session learning.

candidate_id.description: Candidate id this lesson belongs to; defaults to current selected open candidate.

lesson.description: Lesson learned from failure, QA issue, or design concern.

next_action.description: Specific next action that should use this lesson.

severity.description: info, warning, or error. Defaults to info.

source.description: Source that produced the lesson; defaults to self-augment.

name: self_augment_lesson

description: Run the self-verification loop. Defaults to quick one-iteration verification; set full=true for the full gate with at least 10 seeded iterations. Termination requires every concrete goal score to be greater than target_score.

full.description: Run the full ten-plus-iteration verification gate. Defaults to false quick mode.

iterations.description: Full-gate iteration count; requires full=true and must be at least 10.

save_state.description: When true, save compact summary to harness state after the run.

seed.description: Base seed for deterministic per-iteration fuzz fixtures.

state_key.description: State key for save_state; defaults to self-verify-latest.

target_score.description: Exclusive per-goal score threshold; defaults to 95.

name: self_verify

description: Export the self-verification loop improvement candidate curriculum, including open/satisfied IDs and the next selected candidate.

save_state.description: When true, save the candidate export snapshot to harness state.

state_key.description: State key for save_state; defaults to self-verify-candidates-latest.

name: self_verify_candidates

description: List saved self-verification loop summary checkpoints from harness state, sorted by snapshot generation time for quick baseline/candidate discovery.

confirm.description: When true with prune_retention, delete retention candidates beyond retention_limit.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return; defaults to 20, 0 returns all.

prefix.description: State key prefix to scan; defaults to self-verify. Use empty string to scan all keys.

prune_retention.description: When true, plan retention pruning. This is a dry-run unless confirm is also true.

retention_limit.description: Maximum matching summaries to retain by newest-first ordering. Omit or use 0 to disable retention planning.

name: self_verify_history

description: Compare two saved self-verification loop summary checkpoints from harness state and report elapsed-time, failed-step, step-label, and goal-score regressions.

baseline_key.description: State key containing the baseline self-verification summary snapshot.

candidate_key.description: State key containing the candidate self-verification summary snapshot.

max_elapsed_regression_pct.description: Allowed elapsed_ms increase percentage before regression; defaults to 20.

name: self_verify_compare

description: Promote a saved self-verification loop summary checkpoint to a baseline state key. Defaults to dry-run; pass confirm=true to write the baseline.

allow_failed_source.description: Promote even when the source snapshot did not pass the gate (baseline-poisoning override; off by default).

baseline_key.description: State key to write as the promoted baseline.

confirm.description: When true, write baseline_key; false or omitted performs a dry-run.

from_key.description: State key containing the candidate self-verification summary snapshot to promote.

name: self_verify_promote

description: Return the current CLI/MCP compatibility contract, required response fields, and stable schema hash. This tool is read-only and is used before changing response DTOs.
name: contract_schema

description: Check whether the current CLI/MCP compatibility contract is internally consistent. This tool is read-only and returns a pass/fail result plus warnings.

description: Read a no-shell local worker job by id. This is read-only and returns the persisted job lifecycle record.

description: List no-shell local worker jobs from the harness worker state directory. This is read-only.
name: worker_list

description: Mark a queued no-shell local worker job as cancelled. This writes only the job lifecycle record and never kills processes.
name: worker_cancel

argv.description: Command argv array. Shell strings are not accepted.

audit_log_id.description: Optional caller-provided audit log correlation id.

cwd.description: Command working directory; must be inside workspace_root.

shell_allowed.description: Whether shell interpreter argv[0] is allowed.

shell_reason.description: Required reason when shell_allowed is true.

repo.description: Target repository path. Defaults to current directory.

staged.description: When true, suggest commit based on staged changes (git diff --cached); otherwise unstaged. Defaults to false.

command_argv.description: The command argv array to run and diagnose.

model.description: Z.AI Coding Plan model. Defaults to glm-5-turbo.

repo.description: Target repository path. Defaults to current directory.

description: Run the clean-room resilient public web fetch engine with safe URL handling, route accounting, response validation, and citation-ready output.
name: web_fetch_resilient
